digest.component_or_area: code-review gate, plan-review gate, completion gate; per-pass LLM model resolution
propositions: code-review gate steps (base, round_a, round_b, coach) inherit single cfg.model implicitly instead of declaring per-pass model classes (frontier for Pass-1, standard for Pass-2/Pass-4)

one environment variable (REBAR_LLM_MODEL) cannot express the required four-pass model mapping (41 opus calls on Pass-1 finder, 1 sonnet call on Pass-2/Pass-4 verifier under measured production behavior)

verifier downgrade to sonnet for Pass-2 and Pass-4 stops applying when cfg.model is set to any non-default provider, causing opus to be used where sonnet is required, triggering temperature deprecation errors
bare claude-* model names in plan-review ladder or inherited by gate steps resolve to provider anthropic even during runs configured for non-default providers like bedrock
batch step model declarations are silently ignored because interpreter.py only reads model_ladder from batch sub-dict, not step-level model key

per-provider model mapping mechanism (model_classes.py with frontier/standard/trivial slots and REBAR_LLM_<CLASS>_<FIELD> overrides) exists but gate steps do not declare their class, leaving resolution non-deterministic
